name: WJA Landscaping
hours: Mon to Sat 7 am to 5 pm. Closed Sun.
description: WJA Landscaping designs and builds outdoor living spaces, patios, outdoor kitchens, driveways, pavilions, and retaining walls for Collegeville, Limerick Township, Gilbertsville, and Chester and Montgomery counties.
tagline: Landscaping design and installation, Collegeville PA

hero.headline: Outdoor living spaces, built to last in Collegeville
hero.sub: Patios, outdoor kitchens, driveways, and hardscaping for Collegeville, Limerick, and Gilbertsville, with personalized service and transparent communication.

offerings.heading: Hardscape that <mark>holds.</mark>
items: Patios, walkways, steps, and pool decks in pavers and stone
Outdoor kitchens, fireplaces, fire pits, and seating walls
Pergolas, pavilions, driveways, retaining walls, and paver sealing
Locally owned and operated in Collegeville
Serving Limerick Township, Gilbertsville, and Chester and Montgomery counties
Mon to Sat 7 am to 5 pm

story.heading: Personalized service, transparent communication
paragraphs: WJA Landscaping is locally owned and operated in Collegeville, and takes pride in personalized service, transparent communication, and high-quality craftsmanship in every project.
Patios, kitchens, and pavilions get drawn for the property they will sit on, then built by the crew that quoted them.

experience.heading: From estimate to first fire
items: A site visit and a clear quote with materials and schedule.
Design and installation by one team.
A walk-through when finished, sealing when it is time.

feature.heading: Custom pavilions
feature.text: A pavilion turns a patio into a room with weather, built to match the house with the kitchen and lighting planned underneath.

closing.heading: Design and installation for Collegeville, Limerick, and Gilbertsville
